Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about LUMIZA.

cordless.question: Is the lamp cordless?
cordless.answer: Yes. LUMIZA is designed to operate without a cable while in use and to be moved easily.

recharge.question: How is the lamp recharged?
recharge.answer: Charging is planned via USB. Battery life and charging time still need to be confirmed.

colors.question: Which colours are available?
colors.answer: Black, gold and silver finishes are planned, subject to final supplier confirmation.

multiple.question: Can I order several lamps?
multiple.answer: Choose SOLO for one lamp, DUO for two or PRO for ten, then adjust the number of packs in your selection.

shipping.question: Do you ship outside France?
shipping.answer: Delivery is available to France, Belgium, Germany and Switzerland. Shipping charges are shown at checkout. Estimated delivery within {min}–{max} business days.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: Card payments are processed in Stripe’s secure interface. LUMIZA does not store your full card number.

contact.title: Contact

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.introduction: This page describes the data categories used by the current LUMIZA checkout and website. Retention periods and the controller's identity still need confirmation.

orders.title: Orders and delivery
orders.body: Checkout and order records contain the selected products, quantities, country, order reference and payment-related identifiers. Stripe may provide a customer's name and email after payment. Stripe collects delivery address information through its checkout interface; LUMIZA does not currently copy the full address into its order database.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Card entry takes place in Stripe's embedded payment interface. LUMIZA stores a Stripe checkout session identifier and, when available, a payment-intent identifier, not full card numbers.

technical.title: Technical data
technical.body: The cart is kept in local storage; a checkout-attempt identifier is kept in session storage. Theme and consent preferences may also be stored in this browser. Server and payment-provider logs may contain technical information needed for operation and security.

sharing.title: Service providers and rights
sharing.body: Supabase supports order data storage and Stripe processes payments. A verified privacy contact, retention schedule and procedure for privacy requests must be defined before production. No analytics or marketing tracker is currently enabled.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.introduction: The structure below explains the current ordering flow. Undecided seller policies must be confirmed before these terms can govern real sales.

seller.title: Seller and products
seller.body: The seller's legal identity is pending. LUMIZA currently presents one lamp in Black, Gold and Silver selections with SOLO, DUO and PRO packs; final product specifications and finish availability require verification.

prices.title: Prices and payment
prices.body: Prices are displayed in EUR. The server verifies the product price and shipping charge before creating a card checkout with Stripe. Tax treatment and production payment configuration remain to be decided.

ordering.title: Ordering and confirmation
ordering.body: The customer reviews the cart, selects a supported delivery country and enters payment and delivery details through Stripe. An order is confirmed only when payment is successfully recorded; a private confirmation page shows the order reference.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Supported destinations and per-order charges are set out in the seller information below. Estimated delivery within {min}–{max} business days.

afterSale.title: Withdrawal, returns, refunds and defects
afterSale.body: The withdrawal right, return procedure and refund rules are set out below. Rights concerning defective or non-conforming goods remain separate; no additional commercial guarantee is promised.

disputes.title: Support and disputes
disputes.body: The customer-service contact appears below. Applicable dispute-resolution information still needs to be completed before launch. No liability limitation has been adopted in this draft.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping and returns
shippingReturns.introduction: Delivery destinations, charges, estimated times and return arrangements are shown below; Swiss import treatment still needs confirmation.

destinations.title: Destinations and charges
destinations.body: Supported destinations and charges per order appear in the information below. The charge is not multiplied by packs, items or quantity.

timing.title: Delivery times
timing.body: Estimated delivery within {min}–{max} business days for supported destinations. Handling of delays must be verified before production sales.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.body: The return address, withdrawal procedure and refund rules appear below. They are separate from rights concerning defective or non-conforming goods.

switzerland.title: Switzerland
switzerland.body: LUMIZA's shipping charge does not determine import VAT, customs duties or potential processing charges. Who bears them must be confirmed before production; no duties-paid or taxes-included promise is made.

cookies.title: Cookies and preferences
cookies.introduction: You can manage optional analytics and marketing preferences at any time using the footer link.

necessary.title: Necessary technologies
necessary.body: The cart, checkout-attempt identifier, theme preference and consent decision support the site's current functions. These do not require optional analytics or marketing consent.

optional.title: Optional categories
optional.body: Analytics and marketing both start switched off. No analytics, Meta Pixel, Meta CAPI or other marketing script has been installed. Future optional scripts must check your choice before loading.

control.title: Your control
control.body: Use Cookie preferences in the footer to review or change your choice. Rejecting optional categories does not block checkout.
